note: Commissioned engravings for law pages, made with ChatGPT in one house style (copperplate engraving, cream paper, one oxblood accent). Files: assets/img/plates/<slug>-hero|scene(.webp, -800.webp; hero also .jpg for sharing). Import with scripts/plate-import.sh. categories lists the bg-<category>.webp plates that exist.

hero.alt: Engraving of factory workers cheering as they pour a mountain of tiny nails toward a quota gauge, while a top-hatted manager studies the gauge instead of the nails
hero.caption: The gauge says the quota is met

scene.alt: Engraving of a Victorian schoolroom where pupils recite memorised answers to an inspector with a checklist while real books gather dust on the shelves
scene.caption: Teaching to the test
